_note: HOODSTARWORLD: THE JOURNEY — live-action scenes, no narrator. t=talk lines are spoken on camera (lip-synced). w maps cast id (or 'prop') to a wardrobe id.

episodes.title: The Beginning
episodes.score: Cinematic hip-hop film score, dark boom-bap drums under low strings and a soulful piano loop, building and triumphant, movie trailer energy, no vocals, no lyrics.

shots.v: night rooftop over Newark, Hoodstar in a black hoodie and work gloves flicks bleach from a spray bottle across a t-shirt pinned flat on a plywood table, the bleach blooming into the fabric, mist hanging in the work light, slow push in

shots.s: dre: Bro, you been up here all night? | hoodstar: Every night. Till it's right.
shots.v: Dre steps out of the rooftop door holding two coffees, Hoodstar keeps working at the table without looking up, then glances at him
close up, Hoodstar's gloved hands lift the finished t-shirt up into the work light, fabric swinging, he turns it toward camera so the full design is seen

shots.s: marisol: Wait. This one is crazy. | hoodstar: Ain't no two alike. Just like us.
shots.v: Marisol walks up wearing the t-shirt, spins once to show it off, smiling at Hoodstar, he leans back against the table and smirks
sunrise on the rooftop, Keisha and Dre pull on their new t-shirts, Keisha fixes her braids over the collar, Dre laughs and pops his collar, gold light flaring
slow motion, the four of them walk shoulder to shoulder down the middle of a Newark block at night toward camera, people on the corner turn their heads, low tracking shot

shots.s: tito: Bleach on a t-shirt? That's the plan? | hoodstar: Nah. That's the story.
shots.v: Tito laughs from his stoop as the crew passes, Hoodstar stops, turns to face him, calm and steady

shots.s: kid: Yo, where I get one? | dre: You don't. One of one.
shots.v: a young man on the corner jogs up to Dre pointing at his shirt, Dre grins and keeps walking backwards to catch up with the crew
hero shot, the crew stands under a single streetlight, camera slowly circles them from a low angle, Hoodstar looks straight into the lens, steam rising from a grate
